project_type: Next.js 15 PWA (App Router) + Express backend + Python FastAPI ML engine
build_system: Next.js 15.3.4 with Tailwind CSS 3.4, no build tooling config needed
test_framework: None configured - manual testing via dev server
test_command: cd frontend && npm run dev (manual testing at localhost:3000)
verification_instructions: Start three processes: (1) cd ml-model && python recommendation_engine.py on :8001, (2) cd backend && node server.js on :3001, (3) cd frontend && npm run dev on :3000. Open http://localhost:3000 and verify: landing page loads, language switcher works, auth flow creates user, onboarding saves profile, results page shows schemes, document page uploads work, all navigation links function, mobile responsive design renders correctly, no console errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/.next/ directory (Next.js build output, auto-generated on npm run dev or build). No checked-in snapshots. Clear with: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next/ if stale build cache causes errors.
environment_constraints: Backend must run on :3001 (hardcoded in frontend API calls). PostgreSQL must be on :5432 with arthsathi database. The 357.js module error in user's message indicates stale .next cache - must clear it before starting. Never restart dev server during workflow steps - it causes port conflicts. Three-process architecture is mandatory.
contribution_requirements: Must preserve: (1) all localStorage keys (as_user_id, as_profile, arthsathi_lang, as_lang, as_mode, as_results_v2, as_offline_profile), (2) all API endpoints contracts (POST /api/users with phone_number/full_name/state/district/preferred_language/interaction_mode, POST /api/users/:id/profile, POST /api/schemes/recommend, POST /api/insurance/recommend, POST /api/documents/upload, etc.), (3) i18n system in lib/i18n.ts and i18n/index.ts (both exist, use i18n/index.ts for UI strings with t() function), (4) voice features (browser SpeechSynthesis TTS, /api/voice/stt endpoint), (5) offline PWA functionality (service worker in public/sw.js, manifest.json), (6) adaptive questionnaire logic driven by i18n/questions.json (fetched from backend /api/i18n/:lang/questions)
key_patterns: Existing pages use: Tailwind utility classes for styling, 'use client' directives (App Router client components), API calls to process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001', localStorage for user session persistence, async/await fetch patterns with try/catch, mobile-first responsive design (min-h-[48px] touch targets per WCAG), large font sizes (text-xl, text-2xl base), icon-first UI with emojis, loading states with skeleton animations, error states with retry buttons, offline detection via checkConnectivity() function with real HTTP ping (not navigator.onLine alone). Existing color palette: primary #1B6B3A (deep green), accent #F5A623 (warm amber), but user wants saffron-orange primary #F97316, deep green secondary #16A34A, sky blue accent #0EA5E9.
directory_structure: frontend/ contains: app/ (Next.js App Router pages: page.tsx, auth/page.tsx, onboarding/page.tsx, results/page.tsx, document/page.tsx, channels/page.tsx, layout.tsx), components/ (LanguageSwitcher.tsx, LanguageInitializer.tsx, ui/OfflineBanner.tsx, ui/VoiceButton.tsx), hooks/ (useOfflineQueue.ts, useTTS.ts), i18n/ (index.ts with t() function, plus hi.ts, mr.ts, ta.ts, te.ts, bn.ts, en.ts language files), lib/ (i18n.ts with question loading logic), styles/ (globals.css with Tailwind and custom animations), public/ (manifest.json, sw.js service worker, icons/). Two i18n systems coexist: i18n/index.ts for UI strings (import {t} from '@/i18n'), lib/i18n.ts for questionnaire data from backend. Backend is at ../backend/ with Express API on :3001. ML engine at ../ml-model/ with FastAPI on :8001.
